description: This Java class 'RitaApi' provides an interface for interacting with an external third-party API, likely for payment processing or financial transactions, within the Apache OFBiz framework. It manages request and response parameters, configuration for network communication, and includes methods for setting parameters, sending requests, and parsing responses.

classes.name: RitaApi
classes.description: A class that encapsulates the parameters, configuration, and communication logic for invoking a third-party payment or financial transaction API within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a parameter value in the request document after validating the parameter name and converting the value to a string.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specified parameter from the document after validation.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the current request document in key-value pairs.

methods.name: getDocument
methods.description: Returns the current map of request parameters.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends the constructed request to the third-party API over HTTP, processes the response, and returns a new RitaApi instance with response data.
